hunks.baseline: It was long for the soldiers on both sides, who clashed again and again, wielding blazing torches and keen weapons.
hunks.sol: For the soldiers on both sides, who clashed again and again with blazing torches and sharpened weapons.

hunks.baseline: It was long for the people, trembling with fear as they waited for the sudden upheaval to end.
hunks.sol: For the people, who trembled in fear and waited for the sudden upheaval to end.

hunks.baseline: The battle that night was not confined to the Imperial Palace.

The chilling clash of blades and the screams covered the entire imperial capital for hours. Countless people who heard them were reminded of a not-so-distant past: the fourth prince’s coup, which had overturned the Great Nation’s proper order and history from top to bottom.
hunks.sol: The fighting was not confined to the Imperial Palace. The chilling clash of blades and the screams covered the entire Imperial Capital for several shichen. Countless people who heard them remembered the fourth prince’s coup just over a decade earlier, which had overturned the Great Nation’s order and changed the course of its history.

hunks.baseline: And amid this utter chaos, some were gripped by greater anger and fear than anyone else.
hunks.sol: Amid the chaos, some were gripped by more anger and fear than anyone else.

hunks.baseline: “These bastards could be chewed to death and it still wouldn’t be enough…!”
hunks.sol: “Those bastards! I could chew them to death and it still wouldn’t be enough…!”

hunks.baseline: “It’s over. The Embroidered Uniform Guard must have discovered us!”
hunks.sol: “I-it’s over. The Embroidered Uniform Guard must have discovered us!”

hunks.baseline: Dozens of people faced one another across a table inside an abandoned shrine, filled with dust and cobwebs. The shadows of a dim oil lamp flickered between them. Their clothes and ages varied widely.
hunks.sol: Dozens of people faced one another across a table inside an abandoned shrine thick with dust and cobwebs. Shadows from a dim oil lamp flickered over them. They were of different ages and dressed in all manner of clothes.

hunks.baseline: Listening to their cries, an old man suddenly spoke.
hunks.sol: An old man listened to their cries, then spoke.

hunks.baseline: “You’re making too much noise.”
hunks.sol: “Enough noise.”

hunks.baseline: His voice was low, but forceful. At once, as if on cue, everyone fell silent and turned to look at him.
hunks.sol: His voice was low but firm. As if on cue, everyone fell silent and turned toward him.

hunks.baseline: His skin was covered in deep wrinkles, and his frame was slight—proof of the long years he had lived.
But his experienced eyes were clear and deep. His clothes showed signs of mending here and there, yet his bearing was perfectly composed. Both told the story of the life he had led.
hunks.sol: His slight frame and deeply wrinkled skin showed his age. Yet his eyes were clear and shrewd, and though his clothes showed wear here and there, not a fold was out of place. His bearing, like his dress, spoke of the life he had led.

hunks.baseline: “Don’t be swept up in the commotion. The path we must take was decided long ago.”
hunks.sol: “Don’t let yourselves be swept up in this. The path before us was decided long ago.”

hunks.baseline: The old man lifted his lukewarm teacup.
He seemed not to care in the least about the trail of torches drawing closer outside, or the great roar of the crowd.
hunks.sol: The old man lifted his lukewarm teacup, seemingly unconcerned by the trail of torches drawing closer beyond the window or the great roar that came with them.

hunks.baseline: “I don’t know what disaster is unfolding out there, but it’s worked out well for us. Now that chaos has broken out, this is exactly when we must act.”
hunks.sol: “I don’t know what’s happening out there, but it may be for the best. Now that chaos has broken out, it’s time for us to act.”

hunks.baseline: At the old man’s brief words, some eyes lit up. Others trembled, unable to suppress their fear.
hunks.sol: At his brief words, some eyes lit up. Others trembled, unable to suppress their fear.

hunks.baseline: It was why they had gathered here today—and their justification for saving one person alone.
hunks.sol: It was why they had gathered here today, and the cause they had taken up to save one person.

hunks.baseline: “Now…we must set everything back where it belongs.”
hunks.sol: “Now…we must put everything back where it belongs.”

hunks.baseline: The old man’s eyes flashed with a strength unimaginable at ninety years of age. And with a conviction more unwavering than anyone’s.
hunks.sol: The old man’s eyes flashed with a strength hard to believe in a man of ninety, and a resolve firmer than anyone’s.

hunks.baseline: “We will drive those cruel, ruthless traitors—who have strayed from what is right and overturned the natural order—out of the Imperial Palace, and raise His Highness Prince Shangshan to the throne with the strength of the people.”
hunks.sol: “Let us drive those cruel traitors—who have abandoned what is right and overturned the natural order—out of the Imperial Palace. Let us raise His Highness Prince Shangshan to the throne by the strength of the people.”

hunks.baseline: Though they had come here with their own resolve and determination, for a moment they had forgotten, in their rising excitement and fear, what the great undertaking they meant to pursue truly signified.
hunks.sol: They had come of their own resolve, yet amid their rising excitement and fear, they had briefly forgotten what their undertaking meant.

hunks.baseline: *With the strength of the people. Raise a ruler of the people.*
hunks.sol: *By the strength of the people. Raise a ruler of the people.*

hunks.baseline: They differed in age, status, and gender.
But now they were comrades in the same boat.
hunks.sol: They differed in age, status, and gender. But now they were comrades in the same boat.

hunks.baseline: They had each lived their own lives in their own places. Now they had gathered together to set the Great Nation’s enormous ship on the right course.
hunks.sol: Each had lived a separate life. They had come together to steer the great ship that was the Great Nation onto the right course.

hunks.baseline: A few days earlier, an unknown person’s words had lit the fuse hidden deep in their hearts.
hunks.sol: A few days earlier, the words of someone whose identity they did not know had lit a fuse hidden deep in their hearts.

hunks.baseline: “The azure heaven that once shone blue is fading, and dark clouds are rolling in.”
hunks.sol: “The azure heaven fades, and dark clouds roll in.”

hunks.baseline: At the tune that suddenly slipped from someone’s lips, a young Confucian scholar spoke as though entranced.
hunks.sol: As the tune slipped from someone’s lips, a young Confucian scholar joined in as though entranced.

hunks.baseline: An old laborer, his skin darkened by the sun, muttered in a rough voice. In his hand was an axe with a keen, blue-steel edge. Once, he had led an army.
hunks.sol: An old laborer with sun-darkened skin murmured the words in a rough voice. He held an axe with a keen edge that gleamed blue. Once, he had commanded an army.

hunks.baseline: “There, a stream that never runs dry.”
hunks.sol: “There is a stream that never runs dry.”

hunks.baseline: “Luscious fruit, and beasts that frolic.”
hunks.sol: “Fruit ripens there, and animals run free.”

hunks.baseline: “And a home to keep out the storms, and a forest to provide firewood.”
hunks.sol: “There are homes to shelter us from the storms, and woods to give us firewood.”

hunks.baseline: It could no longer be called the voice of just one person.
hunks.sol: It was no longer any one person’s voice.

hunks.baseline: Reciting the tune that had wandered through the imperial capital’s marketplaces these past few days, they rose to their feet.
hunks.sol: Reciting the song that had spread through the Imperial Capital’s marketplaces over the past few days, they rose to their feet.

hunks.baseline: “It can shelter all the people—and more.”
hunks.sol: “It can shelter all the people, and still have room for more.”

hunks.baseline: The old shrine groaned as the people filed out.
hunks.sol: The old shrine groaned as they filed out. The song continued, louder and stronger than before.

hunks.baseline: But the tune that rang on grew louder and stronger.
“So, people. Do not tremble. Do not be afraid.”
hunks.sol: “So, people, do not tremble. Do not be afraid.”

hunks.baseline: The old man, leading the way with his white robes fluttering, stepped onto the damp earth.
hunks.sol: The old man led the way, his white robes fluttering as he stepped onto the damp earth.

hunks.baseline: And whenever his slight frame moved along the rugged mountain path, shadows crouched beyond the darkness rose and followed him.
hunks.sol: As he made his way along the rugged mountain path, shadows crouched in the darkness rose and followed him.

hunks.baseline: Before long, they had become an army. In their hands were dirt-stained sickles, and spears, swords, and axes red with rust.
hunks.sol: Before long, they had become an army. They carried sickles still caked with dirt, and spears, swords, and axes red with rust.

hunks.baseline: They marched toward the faint light of dawn shining from the east, toward the trail of torches creeping up the mountain like a living dragon.
hunks.sol: They marched toward the faint dawn light in the east and the trail of torches creeping up the mountain like a living dragon.

hunks.baseline: And the song rising from their lips became a fervent prayer, a mighty roar.
hunks.sol: The song on their lips became a fervent plea, then a mighty roar.

hunks.baseline: Thousands of pairs of solemn eyes gleamed in the darkness.
hunks.sol: Thousands of pairs of solemn eyes shone in the dark.

hunks.baseline: “Though the raging storm should swallow the Five Sacred Mountains of the Central Plains, it will never dare reach Mount Shangshan.”
hunks.sol: “Though the raging storm swallow the Five Sacred Mountains of the Central Plains, it will never dare reach Mount Shangshan.”

hunks.baseline: The low mountain trembled. Those torches drawing closer by the moment were likely the punitive force sent by the Emperor, who had realized a restoration was underway.
hunks.sol: The low mountain trembled. The torches were drawing closer by the moment. They must belong to a force sent by the Emperor, who had discovered their restoration and meant to put it down.

hunks.baseline: “The lord of Mount Shangshan is one who has Heaven’s protection!”
hunks.sol: “The lord of Mount Shangshan has Heaven’s protection!”

hunks.baseline: They raised their voices even higher.
hunks.sol: They raised their voices higher.

hunks.baseline: Regardless of status, they strained their throats, fighting to suppress the fear welling up even now.
hunks.sol: Highborn and lowborn alike strained their throats, fighting to suppress the fear still welling up inside them.

hunks.baseline: On an ordinary day just a few days earlier, a man in a bamboo hat whose identity they did not know had cast a single sentence into their hearts. Now they shouted it with all their strength.
hunks.sol: Only a few days ago, on a day like any other, an unknown man in a bamboo hat had cast those words into their hearts. Now they shouted them with all their strength.

hunks.baseline: “He is the descendant of the dragon who commands rain and lightning, and a vessel fit for a righteous and benevolent ruler!”
hunks.sol: “He is descended from the dragon that commands rain and lightning, and fit to be a just and benevolent ruler!”

hunks.baseline: And just as their great shout shook the land around them—
hunks.sol: Their shout rang out in every direction.

hunks.baseline: With a gust of wind that felt unusually sharp, a man suddenly appeared through the gray dawn mist and spoke.
hunks.sol: An unusually sharp gust cut through the gray dawn mist. A man appeared from within it and spoke.

hunks.baseline: “That’s quite a good tune.”
hunks.sol: “That’s quite a fine song.”

hunks.baseline: The golden armor on him could not be concealed, even beneath the dried blood in several places.
hunks.sol: Dried blood marked the golden armor he wore, but could not hide it. That armor meant only one thing.

hunks.baseline: It meant only one thing.
At someone’s groan-like whisper, trembling eyes turned toward the torches undulating a few hundred *jang* below.
hunks.sol: At the words, forced out like a groan, trembling eyes turned to the torches rippling a few hundred *jang* below.

hunks.baseline: The moment suspicion became certainty.
hunks.sol: Suspicion became certainty.

hunks.baseline: There was no doubt.
Those were the Embroidered Uniform Guards sent by the Emperor to put down the restoration.
hunks.sol: The Emperor had sent the Embroidered Uniform Guard to put down their restoration.

hunks.baseline: “You shameless bastards! Aren’t you afraid of Heaven?”
hunks.sol: “You monsters! Aren’t you afraid of Heaven?”

hunks.baseline: Some of the restoration army, consumed by rage, were about to rush at the man who was clearly an Embroidered Uniform Guard when the old man, who had led them all despite his age, suddenly spoke.
hunks.sol: Some of the restoration army, overcome with rage, were about to charge the man when the old man who had led them all spoke.

hunks.baseline: “The blood on your armor—whose is it?”
hunks.sol: “Whose blood is on your armor?”

hunks.baseline: The restoration army, poised to charge, stopped moving. The man answered in an even voice.
hunks.sol: They stopped. The man answered evenly.

hunks.baseline: “It belongs to traitors who endangered the ancestral temples and the state.”
hunks.sol: “The blood of traitors who endangered the ancestral temples and the state.”

hunks.baseline: “Then who are these traitors you speak of?”
hunks.sol: “Then who are the traitors you speak of?”

hunks.baseline: “On the small scale, Wei Zhong, the East Depot’s Seal-Holding Eunuch, and those in league with him. On the larger scale, the foreign enemy called Dark Heaven.”
hunks.sol: “On the smaller scale, Wei Zhong, the East Depot’s Seal-Holding Eunuch, and those in league with him. On the larger scale, the foreign enemy called Dark Heaven.”

hunks.baseline: “……Dark Heaven. Dark Heaven, is it?”
hunks.sol: “…Dark Heaven. Dark Heaven, is it?”

hunks.baseline: The old man murmured softly. That name, which had recently drenched the martial world in blood, was not unfamiliar to him.
hunks.sol: The old man murmured the name. He knew of the force that had recently been drenching the martial world in blood.

hunks.baseline: Neither was the voice of the man standing there in bloodstained golden armor.
hunks.sol: And the voice of the man in bloodstained golden armor was familiar, too.

hunks.baseline: The words were cryptic.
But unlike the restoration army, who could make no sense of this strange exchange, the Embroidered Uniform Guard understood what the old man’s brief question meant.
hunks.sol: The question meant nothing to the bewildered people around him. But the guard understood.

hunks.baseline: “It was all done at His Majesty’s command—the imperial decree.”
hunks.sol: “Was all done at His Majesty’s command.”

hunks.baseline: The old man sighed. Some among the restoration army belatedly recognized the man, and their eyes widened.
hunks.sol: The old man let out a sigh. Some in the restoration army recognized the man at last, and their eyes widened.

hunks.baseline: “Th-that’s right. It was that voice.”
hunks.sol: “Y-yes. That was his voice.”

hunks.baseline: They still remembered it clearly.
The voice that rang out distinctly even among hundreds of people.
The man in a bamboo hat who had cast a great stone into their hearts, then vanished without a trace.
hunks.sol: They remembered it clearly: a voice that had carried over a crowd of hundreds, and a man in a bamboo hat who had dropped a great stone into their hearts before vanishing.

hunks.baseline: “I am Lee, once Grand Preceptor to the late Emperor. What is your name?”
hunks.sol: “This old man is Lee. I once served the late Emperor as Grand Preceptor. What is your name?”

hunks.baseline: At the old man’s question, the man—now wearing a golden helmet instead of a bamboo hat—answered.

hunks.baseline: With the respect due to an elder official driven from his post decades ago after being falsely accused for repeatedly advising the Emperor to keep eunuchs at a distance.
hunks.sol: The man, now wearing a golden helmet in place of his bamboo hat, answered with the respect due to an elder official. Decades ago, Lee had repeatedly urged the Emperor to keep eunuchs at a distance, only to be falsely accused and driven from office.

hunks.baseline: His voice, charged with internal energy, pierced the dawn air and reached everyone’s ears.
hunks.sol: His voice, charged with internal energy, pierced the dawn air and reached every ear.

hunks.baseline: “I was unwise and failed to bring about an age of peace and prosperity; I was unfilial and lost the late Emperor and the elders of the imperial family. Yet I have never once been disloyal. Now, at long last, I seek to set the natural order right. hunks.sol: “I was unworthy and failed to bring about an age of peace. I was unfilial and lost the late Emperor and the elders of the imperial family. But I have never once been disloyal. Now, at last, I seek to set the natural order right. Take up the banner of Imperial Younger Brother Zhu Bao and, with those who follow you, eliminate the traitors.”

hunks.baseline: The air stopped.
An unseen shock swept over the restoration army like a giant wave.
hunks.sol: The air seemed to stop. Shock swept through the restoration army like a great wave.

hunks.baseline: Crown Prince Zhu Bao.
hunks.sol: *Imperial Younger Brother Zhu Bao.*

hunks.baseline: Everyone knew what that meant.
hunks.sol: Everyone understood what it meant.

hunks.baseline: Jeong Hogun walked slowly toward them, carrying a banner. Beside the dragon embroidered in gold thread was the name Zhu Bao. At the sight of it, even the slightest doubt vanished.
hunks.sol: Jeong Hogun walked slowly toward them with a banner in his hand. Beside a dragon embroidered in gold thread was Zhu Bao’s name. The sight erased their last shred of doubt.

hunks.baseline: As cries of wonder rose all around him, the old man swallowed. He fought back the tears welling in his wrinkled eyes.
hunks.sol: Cries of wonder rose all around him. The old man swallowed and fought back the tears gathering in his wrinkled eyes.

hunks.baseline: Then, in the next moment, he fell to both knees and accepted the Crown Prince’s banner with trembling hands.
hunks.sol: Then he dropped to both knees and accepted the Imperial Younger Brother’s banner in trembling hands.

hunks.baseline: “I receive and obey His Majesty’s most solemn imperial command.”
hunks.sol: “I receive and obey His Majesty’s solemn command.”

hunks.baseline: With the light of dawn growing clear in the far west, the roar of thousands who had joined forces with the Embroidered Uniform Guard woke the early morning.
hunks.sol: As the light of dawn grew clearer in the far west, the roar of thousands who had joined the Embroidered Uniform Guard broke the early-morning stillness.

hunks.baseline: They roused the people who had been paralyzed with fear, and the loyal men who had already lost all hope. Then they fell upon the traitors, who were still fighting bloody battles throughout the imperial capital.
hunks.sol: They roused the people who had been paralyzed with fear and the loyal men who had already given up hope. Then they fell upon the traitors still locked in bloody fighting throughout the Imperial Capital.

hunks.baseline: “Long live the Emperor!”
hunks.sol: “Long live His Majesty the Emperor!”

hunks.baseline: That dawn was painted with countless screams and blood.
hunks.sol: Dawn was stained with countless screams and blood.

hunks.baseline: And when the unusually dark, long night ended and daylight broke, no more battles were fought.
Only the shouts of those pursuing the rebel forces, who had lost the will to fight and scattered in every direction, and their overflowing joy remained.
hunks.sol: When that unusually dark, long night ended and daylight came, there were no more battles. Only the shouts of those pursuing the rebels, who had lost the will to fight and scattered in every direction, and their overflowing joy remained.

hunks.baseline: Then three days passed in the blink of an eye, and one person opened his eyes.
hunks.sol: Then three days passed in the blink of an eye, and someone opened their eyes.
